validation: Every typed reference resolves uniquely to an already committed immutable record; only publication/resolution events list produced objects, after those objects commit.
Reject self-edge, cycle, forged parent, wrong type, dangling reference or unauthorized cross-session/RUN link
Cross-run repair requires explicit DECISION and retains failed RUN
Exclusive claim and budget transitions serialized; nonexclusive evidence siblings may be concurrent
Causal order follows committed sequence and parent commitment, never UTC alone
Writer authentication, payload digest, parent commitments and externally trusted checkpoint/root required for tamper and truncation detection
Closure certificate binds terminal event, graph frontier, expected manifest and completeness checks; missing closure means INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE
truth_boundary: Intent proves intent, not effect. Result needs supporting observations. DAG alone does not prove completeness or truth.
commit_protocol: Commit ACTION/OBSERVATION event with backward causal parents only and empty produced/evidence lists.
Commit EVIDENCE, ARTIFACT, FINDING or DECISION record referencing prior causing event.
Commit separate PUBLICATION/RESOLUTION event with produced IDs and evidence IDs now pointing backward to committed records.
Commit terminal closure only after graph frontier and manifest verified.

edge_semantics.derived_forward_view: Search/index may project from cause to produced records but is rebuildable and never authoritative.
